summary: This Form 8-K by MetLife, Inc. reports routine quarterly earnings results and financial condition for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes an earnings release, quarterly financial supplement, total AUM fact sheet, and an earnings call presentation. No special-situation terms, M&A, restructuring, or strategic corporate events are described. The filing is a standard periodic update for investors and does not trigger a special-situation category. It serves as a routine current report on operating performance.
